title: Pythia: A Suite for Analyzing Large Language Models Across Training and Scaling
authors: S. Biderman, H. Schoelkopf, Q. Anthony, et al. (13 authors)
before: Open models were released as final checkpoints with no training history.
problem: You cannot study how capabilities emerge if you only see the finished model.
breakthrough: Sixteen models across scales, trained on identical data in identical order, with 154 checkpoints each released.
why: It turned training dynamics into something outsiders could actually study, including memorisation and bias formation.
next: OLMo extended the fully-open approach to frontier-adjacent scale.
inherits: Open checkpoints and data order as research infrastructure.
